=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:655-682 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The broker re-run in plan_evidence_broker_round (`claude_run PLAN ... || rerun_rc=$?`) does not handle Claude's capacity-wait exit code 80, so it falls into `PERSIST broker outcome=rerun_failed rc=80`, drops the hash file, keeps the first evidence-request output and never writes `SKIP_PLAN=true` / `CLAUDE_CAPACITY_WAIT=true` to GITHUB_ENV the way the attempt loop does at lines 558-567.
  WHY: When the pool is gated, plan.yml parses the `STATUS: NOT_CLEAR` evidence-request plan, and the self-check gate parks the issue for a human instead of deferring it to the hourly resume pass (#7370). Severity disagreement: gemini=BLOCKER, the other four=MAJOR; the highest is used.
- scripts/evidence_broker.py:583-591,508-510 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_run_log_tail` cuts the job log to its last 4 KiB (`raw[-ANSWER_MAX_BYTES:]`) before `redact_secrets` runs in `Broker.answer`, so a credential that crosses the cut loses the prefix the redactor matches on.
  WHY: The unredacted suffix is sent to the second planner pass and can appear in the posted plan. Severity disagreement: gemini=BLOCKER, minimax/luna/glm=MAJOR; the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 checked this pass-1 claim and did not confirm it: `lines = lines[1:]` drops the partial first line before redaction.
- scripts/evidence_broker.py:583-593 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_run_log_tail` fetches the log using only `fields["job"]` and never checks that the job belongs to `fields["run"]`.
  WHY: A mismatched run/job pair returns another run's log under a fence that names the requested pair, so the planner attributes evidence to the wrong run. Severity disagreement: gemini=MAJOR, minimax/luna/glm=NIT; the highest is used.
- scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:673-682 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The broker round accepts the re-run output and overwrites `CODEX_OUTPUT_FILE` without the `plan_output_contradicts_ref_context` check that the attempt loop applies at lines 574-587.
  WHY: When PLANNING_REF_MISMATCH=false, a spurious `BLOCKED: integration branch mismatch` from the re-run becomes the final plan (the #7172 failure mode). Severity disagreement: gemini/minimax=MAJOR, luna/glm=NIT; the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 did not confirm this as a regression: the attempt loop also keeps a contradicting output on its final attempt (lines 585-587).
- scripts/evidence_broker.py:320-340 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `.git` check in path_reason is case-asymmetric (`parts[0].lower() == ".git"` vs a case-sensitive `".git" in parts`), so paths like `foo/.GIT/bar` pass the lexical gate.
  WHY: Such paths get past the broker's lexical `.git` refusal and rely only on `codex_isolated_workspace.readonly_allowed`. Severity disagreement: gemini=MAJOR, minimax=NIT; the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 did not confirm this: readonly_allowed lowercases every part and checks it against READONLY_BAD_PARTS, which contains ".git".
- scripts/evidence_broker.py:543-562 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `Broker._git_diffstat` runs `git show --numstat` with default rename detection, so renamed paths appear as `old => new` / `dir/{old => new}`; that combined string gets past `_path_shown` / `readonly_allowed` (e.g. `deploy/{.env.prod => .env.example}`).
  WHY: A renamed credential-named file leaks its file name (not its contents) to the planner instead of `(filtered path)`. Suggested fix: add `--no-renames`.
- scripts/evidence_broker.py:553-565 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_git_diffstat` cuts the output to `DIFFSTAT_MAX + 1` (201) lines with no omission marker, unlike `cap_lines`, `_git_show` and `assemble`.
  WHY: For a commit touching more than 200 files, the planner reads a truncated diffstat as complete.
- scripts/evidence_broker.py:530-539 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The diffstat output is hard-sliced to 201 lines without an omitted-lines marker (_git_diffstat loop at lines 530-539).
  WHY: For commits with more than 200 files, the planner works on incomplete evidence while believing it is complete.
- scripts/evidence_broker.py:270-295 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The parse_requests cap (`if len(result["requests"]) >= cap:`) counts accepted requests, not EVIDENCE_REQUEST lines, which contradicts prompts/mode-plan-evidence-request.txt line 37 ("Lines beyond the tenth, duplicates and unknown kinds are refused.").
  WHY: A valid request after the tenth line is still served when earlier lines were refused. API calls stay bounded at 10, so this is a contract mismatch only.
- scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:655-669 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On the rc=75 codex fallback inside the broker round, `PLAN_ENGINE="codex"` is set but `plan_engine_name` is not updated (the loop updates it at line 554).
  WHY: The logs attribute the re-run to Claude when Codex ran it. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 did not confirm this: the line 653 log is printed before the dispatch.
- tests/test_workflow_untrusted_input_contract.py:1041-1044 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `if __name__ == "__main__": run_all_contract_tests()` block runs before the P11 `test_evidence_broker_*` functions are defined, and `run_all_contract_tests` iterates `globals()` when it is called.
  WHY: `python3 tests/test_workflow_untrusted_input_contract.py` reports a pass without running the broker contract tests. Pytest collection in ci.yml is not affected.
- scripts/evidence_broker.py:399-435 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `self.owns_ref = True` is set before the fetch in `Broker.ensure_history`, so after a failed fetch `Broker.cleanup` runs `update-ref -d refs/persist/history` on a ref that was never created and sets `partial` with `history_ref_cleanup_failed`.
  WHY: Telemetry reports a harmless no-op as a partial failure. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 did not confirm this: deleting an absent ref succeeds, and evidence_pack.py line 406 relies on that behaviour.
- scripts/evidence_broker.py:263-295 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `has_trigger` accepts `PLAN_SELF_CHECK: BLOCKER: evidence needed` anywhere in the output as long as the final non-empty line is `STATUS: NOT_CLEAR`; it does not require the trigger and request lines to form the closing block.
  WHY: A plan that quotes those markers outside a code fence can trigger validated host-side reads even though it did not end with the evidence-request contract.
- tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py:test_template_parity | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The new GitHub API calls in scripts/evidence_broker.py are not registered in the GitHub API write guard test suite.
  WHY: This bypasses the mandatory audit and permission controls (CLAUDE.md Section 23.H). z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rebutted this: the calls are read-only GETs through `gh_api_retry.call(optional=True, max_attempts=1)`, the write-guard surface is not touched, and every path is gated behind `PERSIST_EVIDENCE_BROKER_ENABLED` (default off).
- (PR-level — pre-push test gate):n/a | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate reports "Status: fail / Failures caused by this change: 13" (test_gh_api_write_guard.py, test_operator_step_issue.py, test_agents_fragment_contract.py, test_ai_labels.py, test_pr_merge_status_guard.py, test_pr_watch_guard.py, test_no_session_automation.py, test_orchestrate_lib.py, test_persist_orchestrator.py, test_persist_postmerge_verify.py, test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py), but the subjects of those suites are outside the files this PR touches.
  WHY: A red gate blocks the merge and stalls the orchestrator project; the failures must be reproduced on the PR head and the merge-base to separate inherited failures from caused ones.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/evidence_broker.py:Broker._git_diffstat, line 550 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `git show --numstat` rename notation (`dir/{old => new}`, `old => new`) gets past the per-part credential filter in readonly_allowed, so `_path_shown` returns True for e.g. `deploy/{.env.prod => .env.example}`.
  WHY: A renamed credential-named file's name (not its contents) reaches the planner instead of `(filtered path)`. Fix: add `--no-renames`.
- scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:plan_evidence_broker_round, lines 662-682 (vs attempt loop lines 558-567) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The re-run does not handle exit code 80; PLAN_ENGINE stays `claude`, the codex branch on line 670 is skipped, and the function hits `rerun_failed rc=80` without writing SKIP_PLAN/CLAUDE_CAPACITY_WAIT. The HEAL_ROUTE branch (clarify_isolated_run.sh, lines 655-661) has the same gap.
  WHY: plan.yml parses the first evidence-request output, and the self-check gate (plan.yml lines 2133-2138) parks the issue instead of deferring it. Fix: mirror lines 558-567, and add a `_run_round` test for exit 80 in tests/test_evidence_broker.py.
- scripts/evidence_broker.py:Broker._git_diffstat, line 554 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The output is cut to 201 lines with no omission marker, unlike cap_lines, _git_show and assemble.
  WHY: For a commit touching mor
